user.title: EMS-ESP setup
user.description: The gateway itself is always registered as its own device via /api/system/info. Boiler, thermostat, etc. are detected automatically at runtime once connected to the EMS bus.

data_description.api_token: EMS-ESP web UI -> Settings -> Security -> Manage Users -> key icon on the admin user. Leave empty if 'Bypass Access Token authorization' is enabled on the gateway.

zeroconf_confirm.title: EMS-ESP gateway found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found an EMS-ESP gateway at {host}. Confirm the settings below - they must match what's configured on the gateway itself.

data_description.api_token: EMS-ESP web UI -> Settings -> Security -> Manage Users -> key icon on the admin user. Leave empty if 'Bypass Access Token authorization' is enabled on the gateway.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach /api/system/info on that host. Check the IP/hostname and that EMS-ESP is powered on.

abort.not_ems_esp_device: The discovered device does not look like an EMS-ESP gateway.

mqtt_unavailable.title: MQTT live updates unavailable
mqtt_unavailable.description: MQTT live updates are currently unavailable for "{title}" (broker unreachable, or MQTT disabled on the gateway). The integration keeps working over REST, but values update more slowly (up to 5 minutes instead of real-time). Check Home Assistant's MQTT integration (Settings → Devices & Services) as well as the MQTT settings on the EMS-ESP gateway itself. This notice clears automatically once MQTT data starts arriving again.

gateway_unreachable.title: EMS-ESP gateway unreachable
gateway_unreachable.description: "{title}" at {host} is not responding to REST requests. Check that the gateway is powered on and reachable on the network (e.g. via ping or opening http://{host}/api/system/info in a browser). This notice clears automatically once the gateway is reachable again.
